items.name: login-form
items.title: Login Form
items.description: Mobile-first email and password login form using QH Field and form controls.
items.docs: Import @qhkg/react/styles.css once at the application entry. Connect onSubmit to the application's authentication service; do not place credentials or data fetching in this pattern.

items.name: settings-form
items.title: Settings Form
items.description: Project settings form with native submission and QH validation relationships.
items.docs: Keep validation and persistence in the consuming application. Pass invalid to Field and render Field.Error when server or client validation fails.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: Responsive project filter bar that stacks on mobile and expands on wider screens.
items.docs: Use URL search parameters or application state as the source of truth. The pattern intentionally does not fetch data or assume a router.

items.name: delete-confirmation
items.title: Delete Confirmation
items.description: Accessible destructive confirmation pattern built with QH AlertDialog.
items.docs: Use only for irreversible or high-risk deletion. Keep the cancel action as the initial focus and execute deletion only from onConfirm.

items.name: mobile-bottom-action-bar
items.title: Mobile Bottom Action Bar
items.description: Safe-area-aware bottom action bar that becomes an inline panel on wider screens.
items.docs: Add bottom padding to the page content when this bar is fixed so the final content is not covered. Pass QH Button elements as actions.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Project data table pattern with filtering, sorting, row selection, batch actions, states, and pagination.
items.docs: Copy and adapt the ProjectRow model and columns to the application's domain. Keep server fetching, URL state, authorization, and destructive confirmation in the consuming application.

items.name: mobile-nav
items.title: Mobile Navigation
items.description: Drawer-based mobile primary navigation with current-page state and focus restoration.
items.docs: Derive the current item from the consuming application's router. Keep every primary destination visible inside the Drawer and preserve the QH Drawer focus behavior.

items.name: header
items.title: Header
items.description: Responsive application header with synchronized desktop and mobile primary navigation.
items.docs: Pass route-aware items and URLs from the application. The primary action remains visible at every breakpoint, while navigation moves into MobileNav below the desktop breakpoint.

items.name: side-nav
items.title: Side Navigation
items.description: Persistent secondary navigation with explicit current-page state.
items.docs: Use for secondary navigation within a stable application section. Derive the current item from the router and keep primary application destinations in Header or MobileNav.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Page title region combining breadcrumb hierarchy, supporting copy, and visible actions.
items.docs: Render one page-level h1. Keep actions visible, use Button for in-page actions and ButtonLink for URL navigation, and pass router-aware breadcrumb href values.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Responsive list tool area for search, filters, status, and visible actions.
items.docs: This pattern uses labelled native control groups rather than role=toolbar. Only add the ARIA toolbar role after implementing roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation for every contained control.

items.name: project-list-page
items.title: Project List Page
items.description: Complete project list page combining hierarchy, visible creation action, filtering, data states, selection, and pagination.
items.docs: Replace ProjectRow with the consuming application's domain model. Keep router state, authorization, fetching, mutations, and destructive confirmation outside this copy-first page pattern.

items.name: project-detail-page
items.title: Project Detail Page
items.description: Complete project detail page with breadcrumbs, visible actions, overview data, activity, metadata, and resilient page states.
items.docs: Adapt ProjectDetail to the application's domain. Resolve permissions before passing visible actions, keep loading and error state ownership in the route, and use AlertDialog if archive becomes irreversible.

items.name: search-results-page
items.title: Search Results Page
items.description: Complete search results page with a labelled query, category filter, result cards, loading, error, empty state, and pagination.
items.docs: Use URL search parameters as the application source of truth and move filtering and pagination to the server when the result set requires it. Replace demo result categories and URLs with the local search domain.
